scientific_integrity: A proof of the infinite-family formulas is presented. Finite exact matrix and polynomial computations are supplementary reproducibility checks, not a substitute for the proof. Earlier generic Fourier theory and generalized-Petersen spectra are credited.
scientific_limitations: Only labelled GP(n,2) with n at least five, open-neighborhood synchronous parity over F2.
The Smith-gcd return-time expression is algorithmic; it does not provide an elementary classification of maximal primitive periods for every n.
Independent mathematics audit has not been performed; historical equivalence in differently phrased literature remains possible.
title: Two cyclotomic resonance clocks in neighbor-parity dynamics on generalized Petersen graphs
